name: NotebookLM
tagline: Google's source-based research notebook, now called Gemini Notebook.
description: NotebookLM, now called Gemini Notebook, is Google's research assistant for a selected source collection. Add documents, web pages, videos, or audio, then ask questions with citations and create study guides or Audio Overviews. Keep the supporting material available while organizing your research.

features.label: A notebook for your sources
features.text: Collect PDFs, websites, YouTube videos, audio, Google Docs, and Google Slides.

features.label: Source-grounded questions
features.text: Ask about your material and inspect the supporting information through inline citations.

features.label: Study and listening formats
features.text: Create study guides, briefings, mind maps, or Audio Overviews from a source collection.

useCases.label: Study a document collection
useCases.text: Gather course material, ask targeted questions, and create a guide to review key ideas.

useCases.label: Prepare a research briefing
useCases.text: Summarize a notebook's sources and check the briefing against the originals.

limitations: Source grounding does not guarantee correct answers. Check generated conclusions against the supporting material.
Notebook, source, and generation limits vary by plan; availability also depends on account type and region.
Work or school accounts may require an administrator to enable access.
guide.pricingNote: Standard access is free for eligible Google accounts. Google AI, qualifying Workspace, and Cloud plans can provide higher limits or added features; check the official comparison.

faqs.question: Is NotebookLM now called Gemini Notebook?
faqs.answer: Yes. Google renamed NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook. It remains a standalone research product, with notebooks also available through supported Google integrations.

faqs.question: Does NotebookLM provide citations for its answers?
faqs.answer: Its source-based notebook chat provides inline citations so you can review supporting material. Citations help with verification, but generated answers can still contain mistakes.

seo.title: NotebookLM (Gemini Notebook): AI Research Assistant
seo.description: NotebookLM, now Gemini Notebook, organizes your sources for cited answers, study guides, and Audio Overviews. Explore Google's research assistant.
